problemStatement.formal: Let C(x) = |{n ≤ x : IsCarmichael n}|. Is C(x) = x^{1-o(1)}?
problemStatement.plain: Let C(x) count Carmichael numbers in [1,x]. Is C(x) = x^{1-o(1)}? Known: x^{0.3389} ≪ C(x) ≪ x·exp(-c·log x·log log log x / log log x).
whyMatters: Fundamental question about density of pseudoprimes
Connects to Fermat primality test reliability
